description: This line plot illustrates the normalized average gate value across different categories—Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Math, and Code—as the number of experts in a sparse architectural large language model increases from 1 to 64. The x-axis, labeled “Experts,” uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 64, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled “Normalized Average Gate Value,” also uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.20, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 0.05. Each category is represented by a distinct colored line with a corresponding shaded area beneath it: Intent (orange solid line), Summary (blue solid line), Law (yellow solid line), Translation (purple solid line), Math (gray solid line), and Code (green solid line). All lines start near the top of the plot at x=1, with values ranging from approximately 0.06 to 0.20, and exhibit a consistent downward trend as the number of experts increases. The Translation line begins at approximately 0.20 and decreases sharply to near zero by x=64. The Intent line starts at approximately 0.07 and declines to near zero by x=64. The Summary line begins at approximately 0.07 and declines to approximately 0.01 by x=64. The Law line begins at approximately 0.07 and declines to approximately 0.01 by x=64. The Math line begins at approximately 0.05 and declines to approximately 0.01 by x=64. The Code line begins at approximately 0.07 and declines to approximately 0.01 by x=64. A dashed gray line at y=0.00 represents a baseline, which all lines converge toward as the number of experts increases.
